name: WeeklyGoal
summary: The weekly gauge on Today: a label, the figure '4 / 5', five bars and a footer line. Counts quality applications only (fit ≥ 70 or marked Stretch) and shows the stretch quota used. The goal-met moment — fifth bar springs up, figure rolls, footer crossfades to 'Goal met · 7-week streak' — plays once, on the fifth qualifying Done. Under target it says what to do next, never that a streak was lost. StreakBar and the adjust prompt are a later pattern (backlog #12).

done.intent: Quality applications done this week (the app counts: fit ≥ 70 or marked Stretch). May exceed target; the gauge clamps, the figure does not.

target.intent: The weekly target. Also the number of bars.

stretch.intent: Shows 'Stretch 1 of 1 used' under the figure (one per five target). Omit to hide the line.

streakWeeks.intent: Consecutive weeks met, counting this one once met. Appears only in the met footer: 'Goal met · 7-week streak'.

isAtRisk.intent: The app's call (Saturday with ≥ 2 to go). Colours the footer with text.warning and, with nextAction, names the next useful step — never a loss (backlog 0c).

nextAction.intent: The next useful step for the at-risk footer: '2 to go · next: Email Priya'.

lastWeek.intent: Last week's done count for the in-progress footer: '1 to go · last week 5/5'.

footer.intent: Overrides the derived footer for a one-off line such as 'Logged, not counted — fit 58' or a localised sentence. The default footers are English; the app localises by passing its own.

label.intent: The visible label and the meter's name.

a11y.name: role="meter" named by the visible label (aria-labelledby). aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax target, aria-valuenow done (clamped), aria-valuetext '4 of 5 quality applications'.
a11y.announcements: The footer is a polite, atomic live region: when the goal is met it announces 'Goal met · 7-week streak' once; at risk it announces the next step. Nothing else in the widget is live — the bars are aria-hidden decoration and the figure is read through the meter's value text.
a11y.targetSize: Not interactive. The adjust prompt (two real buttons) belongs to the later StreakBar pattern.

rules: It is a meter, not a picture (ADR-035): a quantity in a range, announced as a value with the full sentence as aria-valuetext. The bars are decoration (aria-hidden); nothing in the widget is read twice.
Counts quality applications only (backlog #8). The pattern never decides what counts — done arrives counted. 'Logged, not counted — fit 58' is the app's footer override, shown once.

The moment plays once, on the Done that reaches the target (motion spec 2, 700 ms = duration.moment): the last bar fills from the bottom and overshoots to 1.12 before settling (a keyframe, not a physics spring — ADR-035), the figure's digit rolls up, the footer crossfades. Every other increment fills its bar over duration.fast. Under reduced motion the tokens are 0: bar, figure and footer simply change. Never confetti, never sound.

Under target the footer says what to do next ('2 to go · next: Email Priya'), never that a streak ended; copy never judges (backlog 0c). At risk is the app's call (isAtRisk), shown with text.warning — colour plus words, never colour alone.

Figure face: font.figure.lg with font-variation-settings 'wdth' 112 and tabular numerals, set in this pattern's CSS as the documented rule for the figure role (ADR-035). Digits must not shift width as they roll.

Bars: target × (14 × 36 px, radius.100, gap space.100) — 14 = size.target.sm / 2, 36 = 1.5 × size.target.min. Lit = action.primary.bg, unlit = border.default. The single accent on the Today header is these bars.
StreakBar and the soft goal adjustment (history, onAdjustTarget) are backlog #12, P1 — a later pattern that sits beside this figure, never inside it.

examples.title: In progress with last week
examples.code: <WeeklyGoal done={3} target={5} stretch={{ used: 0, quota: 1 }} lastWeek={5} />
